transcript: Hello, this is calling from your bank security department.
We detected suspicious activity. Share the OTP to verify your identity.
Your account will be blocked in 10 minutes.

scenarios.description: Relative in accident asks for money, secrecy
transcript: Papa, I had an accident and I am at the hospital.
Send 50000 immediately. Don't tell anyone at home.

scenarios.description: Fake KYC verification asking for account details
transcript: We need to update your KYC today or your account will be frozen.
Please read me your account number and the code we sent you.

scenarios.description: Police or legal threat demanding payment
transcript: This is the cyber crime police station. A case is registered against you.
Pay the fine now through this link or you will be arrested today.
I can double your money in 30 days with guaranteed returns.
This offer ends tonight, so transfer the amount now.

scenarios.description: Family member calling from saved number
transcript: Hi, it's me. Are you free for dinner tonight?
Okay, I'll see you at seven.

scenarios.description: Bank calling back about a customer request
transcript: Hello, this is a follow-up on the card replacement you requested.
Your new card will arrive in five working days. Thank you for calling.
